channel.title: new! The Making Of A Missionary Pope: The Journey Of Leo Xiv
channel.desc: From his Chicago roots and Augustinian formation near Philadelphia to decades of missionary service in Peru and leadership in Rome, four places helped shape Robert Prevost into Pope Leo XIV. This special report explores the people, experiences, and communities that formed his global vision and prepared him to become the missionary pope he is today. (60 minutes).
